entities.name: MONDO:0013024
observations: Chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH), characterized by persistent organized thromboemboli obstructing pulmonary arteries.

entities.name: PMID:25449047
observations: Case-control study: 45 CTEPH patients versus 36 chronic pulmonary embolism controls; free iron, hepcidin-25, soluble transferrin receptor, ferritin and sTfR/ferritin ratio did not differ, and iron indices were within normal limits. Authors concluded CTEPH was not associated with iron overload.

entities.name: CTEPH not linked to iron overload
observations: A case-control study found no association between CTEPH and iron overload; measured iron status markers did not differ from chronic-PE controls and were within normal limits.

entities.name: PMID:30088118
observations: Case report of a patient with thalassemia and inoperable CTEPH treated by balloon pulmonary angioplasty; iron overload is discussed as a feature of the underlying thalassemia, not established as an effect of CTEPH.
